podcast.body: This comprehensive hits compilation, released in 2014, covered David Bowie's entire career across multiple labels. Notably, it concluded with a brand new song, "Sue (Or in a Season of Crime)," showcasing his continued artistic output alongside a retrospective of his discography. "Only this 2014 compilation, nothing has changed. Not only covered Bowie's entire career across multiple labels, it also ended with a new song called Sue, parentheses, or in a season of crime."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.body: This was David Bowie's last compilation album released before Black Star. It contained early clues that he was working on new material, generating significant anticipation for his next release. "Ahí ya teníamos las primeras pistas de que estaba trabajando en nuevo material, había alguna cosa nueva."
